egress.terms: Verbatim: "Internet egress: Unlimited@100Mbps (~30TB/Month / ~1TB/Day)" + "Burst egress: 10Gbps 500GiB/month" + "Ingress: Unlimited at 10Gbps". Genuinely unmetered, rate-shaped at 100 Mbps sustained (~1 TiB/day). Not a byte cap.

interface_detail: SSH, SCP, SFTP, FTP(S), HTTPS, public HTTP(S), SSHFS, Rsync, Rclone, Restic, Borg, Docker (rootless), WireGuard/OpenVPN
tooling: rclone native, restic/borg native, plain SSHFS mount — no S3 endpoint
chaining: SSHFS/rclone mount -> AList/OpenList -> Cloudflare in front for the fetch workload. 100 Mbps sustained suits 500 GB-1 TiB/day serving.
limits_note: 100 Mbps sustained egress; 500 MB RAM on storage boxes; RAID5 single-parity
reliability_note: Own DC in Finland, 15+ yrs operating; storage-box tier is 500 MB RAM so Nextcloud-on-box is impractical — use it as a filesystem only.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.

evidence.proved: ... — provider states "Payments are Paypal and Crypto", 14-day moneyback (campaign thread)

notes: 16 TB HDD RAID5 (4/8/16/32 TB tiers). This is the same 16 TB tier of the same M10G STORAGE BOX product line as pulsedmedia-m10g-storage-box, recorded a second time from a different seed spelling
